formulas.name: 两维过去信息特征
formulas.definition: b uses consecutive differences among the last <=64 observed signal values; c is median of velocity[-11:-5] (six prior increments), or b when fewer than11 increments. Start at j>=5; only observations <=j are used. d may be displacement or angular tilt, hence call it a monitoring deformation signal, not uniformly metric translation.
formulas.unit: x dimensionless; time h; slope units of signal/h
formulas.previous_rate_tex: c_j=\operatorname{median}\left\{\frac{|d_k-d_{k-1}|}{s_k-s_{k-1}}:k=j-10,\ldots,j-5\right\}\quad\text{if at least11 increments are available; otherwise }c_j=b_j.

formulas.name: 训练折中位数/IQR标准化
formulas.definition: Fit median/IQR on training likelihood rows only, repeated for inner folds; not exposure-weighted and not estimated using the held-out group.

formulas.name: 线性与固定RBF风险
formulas.definition: Linear basis has3 coefficients; no-age RBF has10. Gaussian centres -1,0,1 and standardized width1 are fixed. Risk is piecewise constant between integration nodes with covariates from the latest observed state at each left endpoint. There is no separately fitted arbitrary baseline hazard and no elapsed-record-age feature.

formulas.name: 含区间失稳和右删失的条件似然
formulas.definition: a_i is the sixth observed signal time (feature warmup), conditional on surviving in the selected record. For interval labels, only observations <=lower endpoint enter predictors; the last observed state is frozen over the uncertain label interval. All13 main event rows are interval labels; exact-event branch is available in code but unused here.
formulas.unit: time h; likelihood dimensionless; density for exact time h^-1

formulas.name: 训练目标与正则选择
formulas.definition: E is the sum of model likelihood-interval widths in hours (including uncertain event-interval width), not guaranteed observed survival hours; N_e is training event count. Objective sums likelihood contributions; inner validation ranks the mean of complete held-group NLLs. Tie in tuning favours larger penalty. b0 is a fixed weak intercept-centre based on that training fold.
formulas.unit: NLL nat; kappa dimensionless numerical regularization

formulas.name: 训练侧乘性风险校准挑战
formulas.definition: Each training group receives predictions from a model fitted without it; final rate scale is selected from those training-side cross-fit predictions. This is not an independent conformal calibration set.

formulas.name: 冻结协变量的24/48/72h概率
formulas.definition: Freeze the issue-time covariates and fitted risk over the forecast horizon; future measured covariates are not supplied. Event is external terminal/main catastrophic failure, not the local first mechanical movement initiation. Probabilities are conditional on this selected case/exposure design.

formulas.name: 模型内条件时间分位
formulas.definition: Finite central95% interval conditional on failure occurring within H under the fitted frozen-covariate exponential distribution. It does not integrate parameter/model uncertainty or supply distribution-free95% coverage. For finite positive risk Q_.975<H; as risk tends to0 the conditional distribution approaches Uniform(0,H).

formulas.name: 可判结局与Brier
formulas.tex: y_{i,H}=\begin{cases}1,&U_i\le s_i+H,\\0,&s_i+H<L_i\ \text{or verified censor followup reaches }s_i+H,\\\mathrm{unknown},&\text{otherwise},\end{cases}\qquad \mathrm{BS}_{\mathcal K}=|\mathcal K|^{-1}\sum_{i\in\mathcal K}(p_{i,H}-y_{i,H})^2.
formulas.definition: Risk issues occur before the event lower endpoint. Do not label unknown after censor followup as a non-event. One retained fixed anchor per physical group gives group-equal scores. Unknown-label bounds use min/max of p^2,(1-p)^2 and average only rows with an issued probability; no probability is invented for abstention.

formulas.name: 95%共形秩的实际样本约束
formulas.tex: k=\lceil(n_{\rm cal}+1)(1-\alpha)\rceil,\quad\alpha=0.05;\qquad n_{\rm cal}^{\max}=13:\ k=\lceil14\cdot0.95\rceil=14>13\Rightarrow\widehat q=+\infty.\quad n_{\rm cal}<19\Rightarrow k>n_{\rm cal}.
formulas.definition: The actual independently reserved calibration-set size is0. Code stores13 only as an upper bound from outer training group count, not13 independent calibration scores. All28 fits record rank14 and unbounded_insufficient_groups; no conformal scores/endpoints were calculated. Even the optimistic13-group bound cannot give a nontrivial finite split-conformal95% score quantile. Necessary minimum for a finite empirical95% rank is19 independent calibration groups, in addition to exchangeability and a proper calibration design.
